text: As a child, Theo was fascinated by the stars and spent countless nights stargazing from the rooftop of his rural home. This love for astronomy was more than just a hobby; it was a bond with his late mother, an astrophysicist who nurtured his curiosity about the universe. She would often point out the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, explaining the water cycle with the same wonder she reserved for distant galaxies, turning simple clouds into portals of scientific discovery and maternal comfort.
